test_cases.title: Verify saving adjusted scores and feedback in all three text boxes
test_cases.preconditions: Team lead is logged in and has navigated to the MN scoring editing panel on a Lead Handling Community Origin call.
steps: Adjust the scoring values in the editing panel.
Enter text in the 'What Went Well' text box.
Enter text in the 'What Can Improve' text box.
Enter text in the 'General Comments' text box.
test_cases.expected_result: The adjusted scores and the text entered in all three feedback boxes are successfully saved.

test_cases.title: Verify downloading the summary of scores, feedback, and call link to local device
test_cases.preconditions: Team lead is on the MN scoring editing panel with adjusted scores and filled feedback text boxes.
test_cases.expected_result: A summary file is downloaded to the local device containing the adjusted scores, the text from the three feedback areas, and the call link.

test_cases.title: Verify emailing the summary of scores, feedback, and call link directly to the agent
test_cases.preconditions: Team lead is on the MN scoring editing panel with adjusted scores and filled feedback text boxes, and the agent's email is configured.
steps: Click the option to email the summary to the agent.
test_cases.expected_result: An email containing the summary of scores, feedback, and the call link is successfully sent directly to the agent's email address.

test_cases.title: Verify completing the save, download, and email actions within two clicks from the editing panel
test_cases.preconditions: Team lead has adjusted the scores and entered text in the three feedback boxes on the MN scoring editing panel.
steps: Click the Save button to trigger the sharing options.
Select the option to email the summary to the agent and download it.
test_cases.expected_result: The changes are saved, the summary is downloaded to the local device, and the email is sent to the agent within two clicks.

test_cases.title: Verify system behavior when emailing summary to an agent with no configured email address
test_cases.preconditions: Team lead is on the MN scoring editing panel for a call where the agent's email address cannot be retrieved.
steps: Adjust the scoring and enter feedback in the three text boxes.
Click the option to email the summary to the agent.
test_cases.expected_result: The system displays an error message indicating the email could not be sent because the agent's email address is missing or cannot be retrieved.
